title: Vertical selection with an evidence-scored sequence

measurement.join_script: Same regex join as the G6.40 section 5 verifier (docs/PROMPTS/packs/B2_revenue_ecosystem_org.md:4367-4371), run over every eustress/crates/engine/modes/*.toml against eustress/crates/engine/src/tool_metadata.rs on 2026-11-15. Script kept in the session scratchpad as g141_join.py; nothing in the tree was edited to produce it.
measurement.wired_ratio_mapping: score = min(10, round(40 * wired / ids)) over the manifest that hosts the vertical, fixed before any total was computed. A 25 percent wired manifest would score 10.

context_drift: Brief section 2 quotes 1999 metadata ids / 30 wired (2026-08-06). Today: 2422 / 52 (grep -cE '^\s*"[a-z0-9_:.-]+" =>' tool_metadata.rs = 2422; grep -oE 'true\),$' ... | wc -l = 52). Two manifests exist that the brief does not list: publicsector.toml (232 / 21) and si.toml (181 / 10).
government 563 / 1 and engineering 174 / 22 are unchanged. business is now 175 / 19 (brief: 155 / 19); civil 247 / 1 (brief: 246 / 1).
GOVERNMENT_MODE.md line numbers hold (section 9 at :692, the one-handler sentence at :713) but the doc's own count is 562 ids; the join measures 563.

Manufacturing registry no longer declares docs/manufacturing/ as its data root. eustress/crates/engine/src/manufacturing/mod.rs:18-23 and :518-523 now make vendors and investors Space-local (DataService/Vendors, DataService/Investors, consts at :536 and :538), created on demand. docs/manufacturing/ still does not exist and git ls-files finds zero DataService/Vendors or DataService/Investors entries, so the brief's 'zero investors, zero manufacturers, zero deals' still holds. purchase.rs and purchase_store.rs are new in that module.
The UofA pilot asset no longer says 'MIT-friendly' or 'open source' (grep -c -i 'MIT-friendly\|open source' = 0); :592 now reads source-available. It is still 100 percent free (:625-627).

G1.40 recorded the CAD Tier-1 read tools as compiled but unreachable on the live MCP server. Today they are registered at eustress/crates/tools/src/lib.rs:149-151 (20 cad_tools registrations in lib.rs) and the eustress MCP server attached to this scoring session lists cad_describe_part, cad_validate_part and cad_measure among 20 cad_* tools. Not invoked here; the ledger row itself was not re-verified.

docs/AUDIT/12_INFRASTRUCTURE.md Feature 1 still says the desktop engine is not built in CI. .github/workflows/linux-engine.yml:48 now runs cargo check on eustress-engine, but only on workflow_dispatch and pushes to ci/linux-build (:5-9), so the founder remains the regression surface for PRs.

chargeable_today.evidence: docs/PROMPTS/artifacts/B2/G1.40/revenue_rail_ledger.json chargeable_today_set = [commercial_licence, desktop_studio, mcp_tool_surface], all three of which a CAD sale rests on; desktop_studio and mcp_tool_surface verified by run. Tier-1 tools registered at eustress/crates/tools/src/lib.rs:149-151 (20 cad_tools registrations) and listed live by the MCP server attached to this session; eustress/crates/cad/tests/ holds 5 files with 42 #[test] (grep -c '#\[test\]'). buyer_reachable_solo.evidence: LICENSE-COMMERCIAL.md is a negotiated instrument with a single contact channel (ledger commercial_licence row); desktop_studio can be handed to a buyer directly (ledger desktop_studio revenue_blocker). A small engineering firm buys software without procurement; no sales team is named anywhere as a prerequisite.

proof_cost_in_builds.evidence: Code exists (eustress/crates/engine/src/simulation/electrochemistry.rs, plugin.rs), but docs/AUDIT/19_REALISM_PHYSICS.md:11 records a lumped 0-D Nernst plus Butler-Volmer model with decoupled thermal state; a result a lab would accept needs new physics in the engine, several serialized builds. docs/architecture/VCELL_CASE_STUDY.md:3-4 is an internal verification walkthrough, not a customer proof.
